title: Molecular Glue cc-885 Inhibits VHL-Deficient Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma via ETS1 Degradation.
authors: Yang, Taowei; Li, Qihao; Ye, Kun; Liu, Kezhi; Zhou, Mi; Chen, Minyu; Liao, Lican; Huang, Kangbo; Wang, Zhu; Deng, Qiong; Wang, Jieyan; Jin, Meiyu; Chen, Xu; Liang, Hui; Zhang, Jiaxing; Luo, Junhang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究分子胶cc-885通过降解转录因子ETS1抑制肾癌，涉及ETS1-EPAS1复合物，但核心是药物降解机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is a common and aggressive form of kidney cancer with VHL mutations present in > 50% of cases. These mutations lead to dysregulation of hypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs) and activation of oncogenic pathways, making VHL-deficient ccRCC a challenging target for therapy. In this study, we identified cc-885, a molecular glue degrader, as a selective inhibitor of VHL-deficient ccRCC. cc-885 promotes ubiquitination and degradation of transcription factor ETS1, which cooperates with EPAS1 (HIF-2alpha) to drive tumorigenesis. We demonstrated that cc-885 selectively targeted the p51 and p42 isoforms of ETS1, disrupting p27/p51 balance and suppressing ETS1 transcriptional activity. Moreover, combining cc-885 with an EPAS1 inhibitor, belzutifan, significantly enhanced the anti-tumor efficacy. Our findings provide a novel and precise therapeutic strategy for VHL-deficient ccRCC by targeting ETS1 degradation and disrupting the ETS1-EPAS1 complex.
abstract_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）是一种常见且侵袭性强的肾癌类型，其中超过50%的病例存在VHL突变。这些突变导致缺氧诱导因子（HIFs）失调及致癌通路激活，使得VHL缺陷型ccRCC成为治疗上的棘手靶点。在本研究中，我们鉴定出cc-885，一种分子胶降解剂，作为VHL缺陷型ccRCC的选择性抑制剂。cc-885促进转录因子ETS1的泛素化和降解，该因子与EPAS1（HIF-2α）协同驱动肿瘤发生。我们证明cc-885选择性靶向ETS1的p51和p42亚型，破坏p27/p51平衡并抑制ETS1转录活性。此外，将cc-885与EPAS1抑制剂belzutifan联合使用，显著增强了抗肿瘤疗效。我们的发现通过靶向ETS1降解并破坏ETS1-EPAS1复合物，为VHL缺陷型ccRCC提供了一种新颖且精准的治疗策略。
